programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Pithamagan
programme.desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: James Martin And Christmas Friends

programme.title: The Great British Christmas Menu
programme.desc: The culinary experts go head-to-head with their mouth-watering dishes. Which delicious fish and main course will impress the judges and come out on top? S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's Night Before Christmas

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge

programme.title: Play of the Month: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: 1974. Drama. Director: James MacTaggart. Stars Stanley Baker, Ram John Holder & Jerome Willis. A man struggles to survive after being shipwrecked on a deserted island. [S]

programme.title: Three Silent Men
programme.desc: 1940. Crime. An inventor of a deadly weapon to be used against the allies is injured in a crash. Surgeon, Sir James (Sebastian Shaw) saves his life but learns of his plot. Stars Derrick De Marney. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Hero. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bill Owen & John Dearth. After the sheriff's brother is killed, the man responsible is taken in by Robin, but tensions soon rise as he struggles to fit in. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Rattan Trunk. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Peter Grant & Jan Holden. Bert Edwards receives a trunk full of Persian rugs. Soon after the luggage turns up at Euston Station with a body inside. [S]

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: Conspiracy Of Silence. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West. [S]

programme.title: The Great Van Robbery
programme.desc: 1959. Crime Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Denis Shaw, Kay Callard & Tony Quinn. An Interpol detective pursues a dangerous thief who has placed his loot into a bank account in Rio de Janeiro. [S]

programme.title: Morocco
programme.desc: 1930. Romance. Director: Josef von Sternberg. Stars Gary Cooper, Marlene Dietrich & Adolphe Menjou. A night club singer and a Legionnaire fall in love, but their relationship becomes complicated. [S]

programme.title: Salvage with a Smile 1940
programme.desc: 1940. Second World War comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner, made at Ealing Studios.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Guns. 1976. Stars Ray Lonnen, Albert Welling & John Cording. Armed robbery is becoming almost a daily event and soon someone will get hurt. What happens if the police meet violence with violence? [S]

programme.title: Della
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Gist and starring Joan Crawford. Della (Crawford), a reclusive matriarch of Royal Bay, watches over the affluent coastal town. Possession, for her, is everything. [S]

programme.title: Banking a Banana
programme.desc: 1961. A previously lost comedy short, starring Spike Milligan, about using bananas as a form of currency.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Man Who Sold Pardons. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Nigel Green & Robin Hunter. A charlatan posing as a monk is going through towns selling indulgences, bearing a forged document from the king! [S]

programme.title: Send For Paul Temple
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Directed by John Argyle. Starring Anthony Hulme and Joy Shelton. Scotland Yard calls in novelist and amateur detective Paul Temple to help track down a gang of diamond robbers. [S]

programme.title: Film Noir
programme.desc: Origins of Noir. 2022. The origins of Film Noir begin with the industrial revolution and with the ideas that that form of mechanised production produces. [S]

programme.title: Blithe Spirit
programme.desc: 1945. Comedy. Director: David Lean. Stars Rex Harrison, Constance Cummings, Kay Hammond, Margaret Rutherford. A newly-married writer and his second wife are haunted by the ghost of his first wife. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life A Flight of Fancy
programme.desc: 1961. How does a homing pigeon 'home'? This film takes a look at the development of the birds, from fledglings to long-distance champions.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. [S] (S1, E09)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel step back to 1947 with warnings for curious children, then it's off to Sweden for a little nostalgia from 1957 and the detectives talk fireworks 50s style and explosive escapades. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
